decisions.reason: The Cognito Sign In page already uses the landing-page background; using that same background for the Tenant Launch Flow does not change the sign-in branding requirement.
The background decision does not change the optional prototype-code deliverable or its target pages.
The policy-document format and new-tab behavior are established by a separate clause in the same message and are unaffected by the provisioning background decision.
The general shell still requires a background and header logo; the source only specifies the particular background treatment for the provisioning flow.
The provisioning-flow background decision does not alter the shared footer's content, placement, navigation, or color.
Panel placement is discussed in a separate clause and already has a same-message ambiguity Event; the provisioning background modification does not affect it.
Reusing a background from another page does not change landing-page copy, section order, or the How It Works sequence.
The source reuses an existing background for the Tenant Launch Flow but does not modify the landing page's own visual direction.
The background treatment and provisioning context do not change reusable responsive breakpoint guidance.
The Tenant Launch Flow background does not change styling guidance for the separate admin workspace shell.
Using the Cognito background for the provisioning flow does not change the established dark theme for website pages.
The provisioning background decision does not affect whether the landing-page header contains navigation.
